parent_objective: audit M2401 consolidated targets and choose bounded next route
blocked_by: M2401 materializes consolidated target rows but does not audit route readiness
repair planning must not proceed from unreviewed consolidated targets
candidate/profile/pack diagnostic guardrails must remain non-ranking
supersedes: direct repair from M2401 rows without audit
scenario-redesign or repair-success claims from consolidation artifacts

public_gates: M2402 must audit M2401 consolidation before repair planning or new rollout
M2402 must decide whether offtrack, collision, and R4 categories are ready for bounded repair planning or need synthesis/stop
M2402 must keep candidate/profile/pack rows diagnostic-only
M2402 must choose a bounded next route without ranking, repair execution, training, paper, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, scenario-redesign, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun M2397 M2399 or M2401
do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits compact target categories and selects whether to proceed to repair planning, synthesize, or stop
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2401 consolidation counts are inconsistent with M2399 slices
stop if consolidated targets are still too broad for bounded repair planning
stop if next route would require candidate/profile ranking
stop if offtrack/collision/R4 categories cannot be guarded separately
stop if branch synthesis is required before any further repair-plan step
fallback_plan: route to bounded repair-plan materialization only if targets are compact and guarded
route to branch synthesis if local-search risk or target breadth is too high
route to artifact repair only if M2401 outputs are structurally invalid
stop if no bounded next route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2401 produced compact consolidated target artifacts

training_stage.stage_objective: effective candidate actionable target consolidation result audit
admission_evidence: M2401 ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count and guardrail_violation_count are 0
allowed_updates: M2402 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit or branch stop
next_stage_criteria: M2401 consolidation completeness is accepted or rejected
repair target and guardrail readiness is classified
a bounded follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2402 audits target consolidation only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2402; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2397 measured panel through M2401 consolidated target artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If targets are still too broad, route to synthesis or stop instead of overfitting another artifact step.
allowed_claims: M2401 target-consolidation artifact completeness accepted or rejected
bounded next-route decision from consolidated targets

no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits compact target categories and must decide whether repair planning is justified
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded repair-plan materialization but cannot establish current-sim or paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2402 cannot justify repair planning from consolidated targets
M2402 proposes another artifact-only consolidation step before repair-plan route
M2402 attempts to rank candidates or profiles
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: The M2401 target consolidation artifact can be audited into a bounded repair-planning route, synthesis route, or stop decision without rerun, repair execution, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: M2401 consolidation completeness is accepted or rejected with explicit counts
offtrack repair target collision guardrail R4 mitigation and diagnostic guardrail counts are interpreted
a bounded follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2402 reruns rollout or executes repair/training/replay/PPO
M2402 ranks candidates, ranks profiles, or selects a winner
M2402 treats consolidation as repair or scenario redesign success
M2402 makes paper finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2402 cannot classify the consolidation result or choose a bounded route

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2401 summary and consolidated target artifacts

decision_rule: M2402 passes if it audits M2401 consolidation into an explicit bounded next-route decision without rerun, ranking, or verdict claims.
